# Load Packages
```{r}
library("tidyverse")
```

# Read in the Data
```{r}
#Clear environment
rm(list = ls())

#Load in all datasets
setwd("/Users/aska1693/Downloads/Chapter3_DUGresearch/dug-research")
arthropods_jun_raw <- read.csv("data/arthropod_data_june.csv", na.strings = c("", " "))
cucumbers_raw <- read.csv("data/cucumber_data.csv", na.strings = c("", " "))
sites_raw <- read.csv("data/DUG_sites.csv", na.strings = c("", " "))
beebox_raw <- read.csv("data/cavitynesters_data.csv", na.strings = c("", " "))
predation <- read.csv("data/predation_data.csv", na.strings = c("", " "))
```

# Explore the data
```{r}
str(arthropods_jun_raw)
str(cucumbers_raw)
str(sites_raw)
str(beebox_raw)
str(predation)
```
# Data Cleaning 

Select subset of site variables
```{r}
#Select which site level variables you want to keep in dataframe
sites <- sites_raw %>%
    select(site_code, Area_m2, WealthIndex, tcc200m, imp200m, tcc500m, imp500m)
```

## Final Predation Dataset
```{r}
#adding site level variables to predation data set
predation <- left_join(predation, sites, by = "site_code")
predation
```

## Final Bee Box Dataset
```{r}
#Pivot bee box data long to get in proper format and add site data
beebox <- beebox_raw %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("C."),             # all the temperature columns
    names_to = c("location", "size"),     # new columns
    names_pattern = "C\\._(top|bot|cent)_(s|b)", # regex groups to extract
    values_to = "temp"
  )%>%
    left_join(sites, by = "site_code") #add site data
beebox
```

## Arthropod Data (June Preliminary Data)
### Functional Groups
```{r}
#Functional groups across sites
arthropods <- arthropods_jun_raw %>%
    group_by(fun_group)%>%
    summarise(n.obs = n())

    #mutate(fun_group = replace_na(fun_group, "Unknown"))
arthropods 
```
```{r}
#Plot of functional groups
fun_plot <- ggplot(data = arthropods, aes(x = reorder(fun_group, n.obs), y = n.obs))+
    geom_bar(stat = "identity")+
     coord_flip()+
    theme_classic()+
    labs(x = "",
         y = "Number of arthropods collected",
         title = "Arthropod Functional Groups",
         caption = "\n The number of arthropods (insects and arachnids) we collected in each functional \n group in vane and pitfall traps across 21 garden sites in June 2025.")
fun_plot
```
### Common Taxa
```{r}
arthropods_taxa_fam <- arthropods_jun_raw %>%
    group_by(fam)%>%
    summarise(n.obs = n())
arthropods_taxa_fam

arthropods_taxa_order <- arthropods_jun_raw %>%
    group_by(order)%>%
    summarise(n.obs = n())%>%
    filter(n.obs > 100)
arthropods_taxa_order
```

```{r}
taxa_plot <- ggplot(data = arthropods_taxa_order, aes(x = reorder(order, n.obs), y = n.obs))+
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.5)+
     coord_flip()+
    theme_classic()+
    labs(x = "",
         y = "",
         title = "Most Common Taxa")+
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 20),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20))
taxa_plot

ggsave("/Users/aska1693/Downloads/Chapter3_DUGresearch/dug-research/figures/June_TopTaxa_plot.png", taxa_plot, width = 6, height = 10, units = "in")
```
